name: peers-charity-monorepo
description: Peer's Charity - Full-Stack Academic Resource Sharing Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "API,WEB" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix apps/api" "npm run dev --prefix apps/web"
scripts.start: concurrently -n "API,WEB" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix apps/api" "npm run dev --prefix apps/web"
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check --prefix packages/shared && npm run type-check --prefix apps/api && npm run type-check --prefix apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test:shared && npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --prefix packages/shared && npm run test:coverage --prefix apps/api

author: Peer's Charity Team
